PRIORITIZE AND FIX EXPOSURES
Focus exposure management on the vulnerabilities that actually matter
Axonius unifies security findings across your tools, prioritizes the exposures that put you at risk, and drives vulnerability remediation from a single workflow.
Get a Personalized Demo
Product Tour
See how security teams use Axonius for exposure management to move from 10k critical findings to the ones that require immediate action.
Exposure management starts where vulnerability scanning stops
Scanners tell you what's wrong — they don't tell you what matters.
Without asset context
, every CVE looks equally urgent, and remediation teams burn cycles on findings that pose minimal real risk.
Axonius adds a
durable context layer
. By correlating findings from your scanners with asset ownership, business criticality, coverage status, and network exposure, Axonius helps your team focus on the vulnerabilities that actually put your business at risk.
Get a Personalized Demo
Why teams choose Axonius for exposure management
Kill security silos:
Stop managing tools; start managing risks. Our 1,400+ integrations across 40+ asset types ensure you see all assets and risks, from ground to cloud.
Prioritize vulnerabilities that actually matter:
Combine business, asset, and security signals to identify the security risks that require top priority — from a server with public access to your data science team's laptops.
Mobilize with speed and confidence:
Identify stakeholders automatically. Automate mobilization via ticket and direct remediation with 1,400+ integrations.

See how exposure management works in Axonius
Step 1:
Kill security silos
Instantly get a complete view of assets and security risks in your environment.
Step 2:
Prioritize risks that truly matter
Combine business, asset, and security context to identify the security risks that require prioritization.
Step 3:
Identify owners, track SLAs.
Identify stakeholders automatically, with risk SLAs and additional context to turn objections into collaboration.
Step 4:
Drive action
Automate mobilization and resolution aligned to your business: from tickets to workflows and direct remediation.
Step 5:
Future-proof your exposure management program
Protect an environment that constantly evolves: whether the change is in what you need to protect, what security tools you use, or due to changes in business.
